ProjectDesc: AmbuTRX is an AI-enhanced pre-hospital stroke communication system that converts paramedic speech into structured clinical reports. It enables key stroke information to be transmitted to the A&E team before patient arrival, supporting faster preparation, more consistent documentation, and improved coordination during time-critical stroke cases.

OrthoSight AI is an AI-powered computer vision platform for rapid, non-invasive spinal alignment and scoliosis screening. It uses automated landmark detection and postural analysis to assess spinal symmetry and generate a structured clinical screening report to support orthopaedic review.
